description: This file defines an Android activity for interacting with the Android KeyStore system. It includes functionality for generating, listing, signing, verifying, and deleting cryptographic key entries stored in the AndroidKeyStore. It provides a UI to manage keys and perform cryptographic operations such as signing data and verifying signatures.

classes.name: KeyStoreUsage
classes.description: Main activity class for managing cryptographic keys in Android KeyStore, including UI interactions and cryptographic operations.

classes.name: AliasAdapter
classes.description: An ArrayAdapter subclass for displaying key aliases within a ListView.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI components, and loads the list of existing KeyStore aliases.

methods.name: updateKeyList
methods.description: Refreshes the list of key aliases from the KeyStore asynchronously.

methods.name: setKeyActionButtonsEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables UI buttons related to key actions.

methods.name: GenerateTask
methods.description: AsyncTask for generating a new cryptographic key pair in the Android KeyStore.

methods.name: SignTask
methods.description: AsyncTask for signing data with a selected key from the KeyStore.

methods.name: VerifyTask
methods.description: AsyncTask for verifying a signature against data using a key from the KeyStore.

methods.name: DeleteTask
methods.description: AsyncTask for deleting a key entry from the KeyStore.
